_about: Limits for bench/perf_check.py on the GitHub-hosted runners, checked against the median of 3 runs. 'measured' is the runner's typical median when the limits were set (Nov 2026, macos-latest, 5 runs). Headroom: memory +35-40% (run-to-run medians spread 115-131 MB, the 2026-11 interface regression was +80 MB); idle CPU several points (it reads 0.2%, the hidden progress-bar bug read 12%); launch is noisy on shared runners, so its limit only catches a gross stall; binary size +5%, so growth is a decision. Raising one: CONTRIBUTING.md, Performance budget.
